title: A Journey in Three
excerpt: MDMA moves through distinct pharmacological phases, but therapeutic approaches treat the session as one uniform event. This essay maps a framework connecting the pharmacological arc to corresponding shifts in technique.

title: Two new meditations: Metta Heart and The House of Jung
excerpt: Two 30-minute audio meditations for the peak phase — a somatic loving-kindness practice rooted in Buddhist metta tradition, and a Jungian guided imagery journey into the depths of the unconscious.

title: Why meditation and MDMA mix
excerpt: Most people assume someone on MDMA would be too scattered to meditate. The research says the opposite — the capacities meditation depends on are not only preserved but often feel enhanced.
